rows.sourceStem: Let $A(n)=\frac{4^{n+2}\times8^{3-n}}{2^2}$ for integer $n$. The value of $A(n)$ is a perfect cube and $2^5<A(n)<2^{12}$. Find the sum of all possible values of $n$.
